items.title: How Gen Z is reshaping marketing, brand building and consumer behaviour: Marico CEO explains - CNBC TV18
items.raw_summary: Gen Z consumers are rewriting the rules of brand building, pushing companies to move beyond traditional advertising towards influencer-led discovery, mobile-first content and digital commerce. Marico CEO Saugata Gupta explains why agility, experimentation and long-term brand equity have become critical in the new consumer landscape.
items.title_pt: How Gen Z is reshaping marketing, brand building and consumer behaviour
items.summary_pt: Gen Z reescreve regras de marca: influenciadores, mobile-first e commerce digital substituem publicidade tradicional.
items.pme_pt: Empresário que entende a importância de reposicionar marca para Gen Z precisa de orientação ao vivo sobre como adaptar comunicação, posicionamento e presença digital sem perder identidade.
